findings.text: follow-on: the guard's own docstring at reckon/crew/promotion.py lines 3257-3260 still enumerates 'the gates, decisions, followups, questions, research and comment sections' as if that list were the whole admitted class, the same as-if-exhaustive wording this node corrected in the test module docstring; it is product source outside this node's write scope, so it is named for a follow-up node.

follow-on: the examples list names 'landed notes' and 'evidence' as data-reckon sections, but the guard decomposes only section[data-reckon] (reckon/crew/promotion.py:3331) while landed notes are div/article[data-reckon] elements that only lose their attribute; the heading 'every data-reckon section' is accurate for sections and slightly loose for a non-section example, which a reader could follow to a wrong assumption about what is decomposed.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, the landed docstring rewrite at commit 87ba073b, both arm logs with their commands and revisions, added_failure_count 0 via baseline_suite and after_suite, no negative control because a docstring-only change adds no control mutation, and an empty follow_ons.

justifications.durability: the change is documentation, so no test reddens if the file text regresses; the six tests in tests/test_landing_commit_carries_only_its_own_comment.py still cover the guard behaviour it documents and passed in both arms.

justifications.fit: the docstring's prose and its double-backtick 'data-reckon' literal match the store-owned-region idiom of the guard at reckon/crew/promotion.py lines 3251-3343, and the change introduces no name the naming rules forbid; the list is now signalled as examples ('such as'), which is the goal.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_landing_commit_carries_only_its_own_comment.py lines 13-16 now present the list as examples of 'every ``data-reckon`` section the store writes', replacing the previous as-if-exhaustive enumeration, matching the guard's own selector at reckon/crew/promotion.py line 3331 (section[data-reckon]).
justifications.scope_discipline: the landed diff touches only tests/test_landing_commit_carries_only_its_own_comment.py, a declared write path, and alters no line outside the module docstring.
